verdict.rationale: Supabase's Realtime feature explicitly supports Postgres Changes (listen to database changes in real-time), Broadcast, and Presence, enabling clients to subscribe to live data updates without polling; docs give concrete examples (chat apps, cursor tracking) and a community post confirms real-world production use with thousands of concurrent connections on the Elixir/Phoenix-based Realtime server. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark/failure-mode evidence specifically for the Postgres Changes subscription path (only vendor docs and a scale announcement are cited).
